add-column: The constant text default uses PostgreSQL's fast-default catalog path without rewriting the one-row-per-organization access states; lock acquisition is bounded by 1s and the statement by 5s.
alter-column: Changing the column default is catalog-only and leaves the stored fast default of existing rows in place, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
add-constraint: The origin CHECK is added NOT VALID without scanning rows, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout; the online phase validates it after the schema lock is released.
